topics.title: The New Yorker calls Sam Altman a "pathological liar" in a bombshell investigation
topics.why: A sweeping New Yorker report on OpenAI's CEO cites former colleagues describing a pattern of deliberate misrepresentation and power concentration — a credibility hit for the company steering the tools knowledge workers use every day.

topics.title: DeepSeek in talks to raise $1.5B at a $71B valuation ahead of an IPO
topics.why: The Chinese AI lab that rattled markets last year is now reportedly lining up a pre-IPO raise targeting 2026 or 2027 — a sign the AI funding boom isn't slowing down.

topics.title: Inception's Mercury 2.5 hits 1,100+ tokens/sec on standard GPUs
topics.why: The new diffusion model matches Gemini 3.5 Flash and GPT 5.6 Luna Low on performance while running dramatically faster and cheaper — a preview of how fast "good enough" AI is about to get even more affordable.
